name: kormilitzin/CliNER
what_it_is: An open-source Python NLP system for clinical named entity recognition in EHR text, implementing the i2b2 2010 schema. Classifies tokens IOB-style into Problem, Test, Treatment, or None using CRF or LSTM models.
measurement: Precision/recall/F1 over Problem, Test, Treatment spans
constraints: UMLS license required for optimal features
i2b2 data license prohibits redistribution of models
UMLS DB built from RRF on first run; requires disk space/time
GENIA tagger must be compiled from C++ source
